text: Analog is an edge-computing company launched by G42 in January 2024; G42 announced an investment in it, and Analog's founder said G42 is its biggest investor.
short: Analog is a G42 venture; G42 is its biggest investor

source.name: G42: G42 Launches Analog, a New Venture to Advance AI Capabilities in Edge Computing
source.quote: G42, the leading UAE-based technology group, today announced its investment in a new edge computing company called Analog

additionalSources.name: The National: Abu Dhabi's G42 invests in edge computing and AI start-up Analog at WEF launch (Alkesh Sharma)
additionalSources.quote: Without disclosing other investors, Mr Kipman said G42 is the biggest investor in the start-up
